title: aconitum lycoctonum var. cynoctonum
intro: Aconitum lycoctonum var. cynoctonum, commonly known as monk's hood, is a variety of the Aconitum lycoctonum plant, which belongs to the Aconitum genus of flowering plants. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Aconitum lycoctonum var. cynoctonum include its analgesic, antipyretic, and hypotensive properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as aconitine, aconitine-8-β-D-glucopyranoside, and hypaconitine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
